narrative: The black-letter folio open on the board under the west window. He is on his feet. The slip is still in the gutter. No face. The same opening, a little further down the column. Two young men, and one lady seen through a window. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the Knight's Tale standing, and did not begin a page.

entities.name: the Chaucer
entities.context: Shown on book in Standing, at the Knight
